title: Field-aware invert of a prior UnlinkAudioVideo command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip UnlinkAudioVideo or LinkAudioVideo command restores only that command's link write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later leave-gap move that translates both unlinked members by the same amount does not conflict: invert of an unlink restores the link and keeps the moved remnants and already-followed cues. Invert of a later relink after a linked move restores only the unlink and leaves the later geometry.

A later relink of the same pair, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Invert of an unlink after a diverging move that breaks the recorded offset is refused by existing document validation as LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH and does not roll the database back; that error code is not retargeted to UNDO_CONFLICT. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered SetAudioTrackState and SetTrackState locked/unlock semantics stay unchanged.

A real UI path extracts persistent audio, splits, adds left and right cues, unlinks the right pair, commits a multi-select leave-gap move of both unlinked remnants, inverts the UnlinkAudioVideo command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip.

Already-delivered unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
